body:
I knew something was amiss from the moment I heard the faint hum emanating from the ceiling above me. My heart pounded as I glanced around, searching for any signs of trouble—any evidence of the light flickering or the air conditioner malfunctioning. The familiar sight of my beloved choir lofts seemed oddly out of place amidst this unsettling noise.

But there was nothing to fear; it was just an early morning incident. The lights had gone on briefly when someone must have accidentally pressed a button somewhere else in the building. No damage done, not even smoke.

Breathing a sigh of relief, I stepped closer to investigate further. It might be a wake-up call to check all systems before another one occurs.

Next: put real distance between myself and it.
